title: The front door
logline: The tavern's front door from the lot, and a man in plaid going in it from behind, the pup sitting outside — the first time in twenty-one years the page has him use the front. The sign above, out of frame.

panels.composition: A tavern's front door from its gravel lot with a man in plaid from behind stepping in, an old three-legged dog sitting outside the door, the sign above cut off by the page's top edge.
